title: [Panel Edit Mode] "Miniature desktop" header buttons overlap each other when screen space is limited or large scaling is used when locale has long words
line: With the panel settings open, the buttons above the small desktop preview no longer overlap: their labels shorten with "…" and Exit Edit Mode becomes a checkmark icon with a tooltip.
explanation: When the panel settings are open, the desktop is zoomed out into a small preview beside them, and with large scaling, a big font and long translations (German) it is only a few hundred pixels wide. Its toolbar is a Flow of buttons (Add Widgets, Add Panel, Manage Desktops) next to the Exit Edit Mode button, and the buttons always kept their full text width, so the Exit button was laid over the first button and the others ran out of the preview under the dialog. The change caps each Flow button at the Flow's width so its label elides, and switches Exit Edit Mode to icon-only (with a tooltip) when its full-width version doesn't fit beside the widest Flow button. Ported from the earlier local fix branch work/fix-527108 (~/kde/more-fixes/04-527108), unchanged.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: don't let edit mode toolbar buttons overlap

Next to the panel settings the zoomed-out desktop can be very narrow,
and its toolbar buttons kept their full text, so they were drawn on top
of each other. Let them elide, and make Exit Edit Mode icon-only then.

BUG: 527108

patches.diff:
From 7bfd4c6d44e811ae0d83df9d1bce328c76464c1b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:31:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: don't let edit mode toolbar buttons overlap

Next to the panel settings the zoomed-out desktop can be very narrow,
and its toolbar buttons kept their full text, so they were drawn on top
of each other. Let them elide, and make Exit Edit Mode icon-only then.

BUG: 527108
---
 .../contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml        | 24 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 24 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
index fd643d976f..cc82fb86ad 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
@@ -95,11 +95,18 @@ Item {
                     margins: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                 }
                 Flow {
+                    id: toolBarFlow
+                    // The widest button, so the Exit button can make room for it
+                    readonly property real widestButtonWidth: Math.max(addWidgetButton.implicitWidth,
+                                                                       addPanelButton.implicitWidth,
+                                                                       manageContainmentsButton.visible ? manageContainmentsButton.implicitWidth : 0)
                     Layout.fillWidth: true
                     Layout.minimumHeight: implicitHeight
                     spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                     PC.ToolButton {
                         id: addWidgetButton
+                        // Elide instead of overflowing when the zoomed-out desktop is very narrow
+                        width: Math.min(implicitWidth, toolBarFlow.width)
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.internalAction("add widgets") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
                         icon.name: "view-group-symbolic"
@@ -108,6 +115,7 @@ Item {
 
                     PC.ToolButton {
                         id: addPanelButton
+                        width: Math.min(implicitWidth, toolBarFlow.width)
                         height: addWidgetButton.height
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.corona.action("add panel") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
@@ -118,6 +126,7 @@ Item {
 
                     PC.ToolButton {
                         id: manageContainmentsButton
+                        width: Math.min(implicitWidth, toolBarFlow.width)
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.corona.action("manage-containments") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
                         visible: qAction?.visible || false
@@ -142,7 +151,22 @@ Item {
                     Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
                     icon.name: "dialog-ok-symbolic"
                     text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Exit Edit Mode")
+                    // Only show the text when it fits next to the other buttons, e.g. not on the
+                    // small zoomed-out desktop next to the panel configuration dialog
+                    display: toolBar.width >= toolBarFlow.widestButtonWidth + toolBar.spacing + exitButtonSizeHelper.implicitWidth
+                        ? PC.AbstractButton.TextBesideIcon : PC.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    PC.ToolTip.text: text
+                    PC.ToolTip.visible: display === PC.AbstractButton.IconOnly && hovered
+                    PC.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
                     onClicked: containment.plasmoid.corona.editMode = false
+
+                    // Not shown, only used to know how wide the button is with its text
+                    PC.ToolButton {
+                        id: exitButtonSizeHelper
+                        visible: false
+                        icon.name: parent.icon.name
+                        text: parent.text
+                    }
                 }
             }
         }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master, German, 1920x1080 at 150%, 15 pt font, panel settings open: the toolbar above the small desktop preview shows "Miniprogramme…" and "Bearbeitungsmodus verlassen" drawn on top of each other, the other labels cut off by the dialog
Same setup with the fix: "Minipr…", "Kont…", "Arbeits…" elided inside the preview and Exit Edit Mode shown as a checkmark at the right
Zoom of the preview toolbar on master: overlapping labels
Zoom of the preview toolbar with the fix: no overlap
With the fix, hovering the checkmark shows the "Bearbeitungsmodus verlassen" tooltip
With the fix, normal desktop edit mode (English, wide toolbar): all buttons keep their full text, Exit Edit Mode included

review.text: This stops the overlap, but the result is weak: the Flow buttons elide down to unreadable stubs ("Kont…", "Arbeits…") with no tooltip, and only Exit Edit Mode goes icon-only. Exit's compact mode is decided by a hidden helper PC.ToolButton nested inside the button, which is a hack and ignores the touch-mode More button. KDE design would expect one consistent compact mode: icon-only buttons with tooltips when the full-text toolbar doesn't fit.
changes: When the toolbar's full implicit width (all visible buttons, including More, plus spacing) doesn't fit, switch every toolbar button to PC.AbstractButton.IconOnly with a ToolTip carrying its text, instead of eliding the Flow buttons
Remove the hidden exitButtonSizeHelper ToolButton; compute the fit from the buttons' implicit widths (e.g. a TextMetrics or a single readonly 'compact' property on toolBar)
